Real Indian food in Phu Quoc for under $30. 100% vegetarian. 4.9 stars.

Maharaja Lounge sits right beside Starbucks in Sunset Town, An Thới. Curries, dal, fresh bread. The kind of meal that actually tastes like home if you grew up eating this way.

Perfect stop before or after the Kiss Bridge at golden hour.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
